## Result: Not achievable with this BaroCSS build

I could not give the Save button a text shadow by editing class names, and I want to be straight about why rather than leave something that looks right but isn't.

**What I tried and verified:**
- `text-shadow-sm`, `text-shadow-xs`, `text-shadow`, `text-shadow-md` → computed `text-shadow` stayed `none`. The engine works (I confirmed `shadow-lg` applies a box-shadow), it just has no such utility.

**Root cause (from inspecting `barocss.js`):** this build registers `shadow-*` (box-shadow), `drop-shadow-*` (a `filter`), `inset-shadow-*`, and ring shadows — but no `text-shadow` utility at all (the only `text-shadow` string in the bundle is a print-media reset). There's also no arbitrary-property fallback. So there is no class that emits the CSS `text-shadow` property.

The button is restored to its original classes; nothing was left in a broken state.

**Closest alternatives, if you want one (none is a true text shadow):**
- `drop-shadow-sm` — a `filter` drop-shadow. On this button it would shadow the whole filled box (because of the solid `bg-blue-600`), not the glyphs, so it's visually a box shadow, not a text shadow.
